newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Algos Pharma upped to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Algos Pharma upped to buy.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Jerry Brimeyer raised the rating on Algos Pharmaceutical Inc to buy from venture.
-- cited positive results of a Phase II clinical trial confirming that MorphiDex has "superior efficacy" to morphine for treating pain.

-- analyst said in research note, "MorphiDex, a combination of morphine and NMDA antagonist, has demonstrated more than 60 percent improved analgesic in comparison to morphine in two separate clinical trials..."
-- said company was in Phase III trials and was expected to file with the U.S. Food and Drug Administration in late 1997, with approval planned for 1998.
